entries.title: What's new
entries.description: This notification center — the bell shows when the site was last updated and lists every new feature.

entries.title: Upload your Electronic Grade Sheet
entries.description: Auto-fill your subject grades and CGPA from the grade sheet PDF — the file is read once and never stored.

entries.title: Semester CGPA
entries.description: Add your semester CGPA (out of 10) and see it on your student details card.

entries.title: Subject grades
entries.description: Pick a grade (A to E) for each subject; it shows as a badge in both Simple and Detailed views.

entries.title: Edit only your own record
entries.description: Other students' detail cards no longer show an Edit button.

entries.title: Till end-sem is the default view
entries.description: Filters now start with Till end-sem, and the Students card shows how many of the total qualify (e.g. 19/76).

entries.title: Hiding your BITS ID is opt-in
entries.description: The "Hide my BITS ID" box now starts unticked — tick it if you want to appear under an alias.

entries.title: End-sem marks + Till end-sem filter
entries.description: You can now enter end-sem marks, and a new filter shows students who have filled everything.

entries.title: Explanations on hover
entries.description: Hover over stats cards, chips and rows to see exactly how each number is calculated.

entries.title: Your own averages
entries.description: Student details now show Avg / subject and Avg marks alongside your overall %.

entries.title: Replies on feedback
entries.description: Reply to feedback comments — official answers carry a ✓ Admin badge.

entries.title: Simple view in student details
entries.description: See marks so far out of each subject's full total, with a compact Simple / Detailed toggle.

entries.title: Under review list
entries.description: Entries that look wrong are held out of rankings and listed under ⚠️ Under review until corrected.

entries.title: Stats follow the filters
entries.description: The top cards (students, topper, averages) recalculate for the filter you pick.

entries.title: ML marking scheme updated
entries.description: ML Quiz 2 is now out of 10 and Assignment 2 out of 15.

entries.title: Anonymous feedback
entries.description: Share ideas or report bugs anonymously with 💬 and upvote the ones you agree with.

entries.title: Compare with students at your stage
entries.description: Till mid-sem and Only end-sem left filters recompute percentile within each group.

entries.title: Delete and confirm before save
entries.description: Delete your own record with your PIN, and confirm before saving so a typo can't create a new entry.

entries.title: Load my saved marks
entries.description: Load your saved marks on any device with your BITS ID and PIN, then edit.

entries.title: ML has its own marking scheme
entries.description: ML Quiz 1 is out of 10 and Assignment 1 out of 5; percentages use each subject's real totals.

entries.title: Hide your BITS ID
entries.description: Appear on the leaderboard under an alias like "Silent Falcon 42" — your ID is never stored.

entries.title: PIN-protected entries
entries.description: A 4-digit PIN locks your entry so only you can edit or delete it.

entries.title: New mobile-first design
entries.description: Podium for the top 3, search, and tap any student to see their full breakdown.

entries.title: Launch
entries.description: Track your marks, percentage, rank and percentile — per subject and overall.
